extractions.value: The key diagnostic feature was the continuous motor unit activity on EMG in axial muscles, which is pathognomonic for SPS and PERM. extractions.value: The patient had a past medical history of cannabis abuse for 18 months and a self-reported episode of depression. Initial drug screening was positive for tetrahydrocannabinol. The patient suffered a jaw and right clavicle fracture causing traumatic mediastinal emphysema due to falls. Anti-NMDA receptor antibodies were not tested. The diagnosis of HL was established 7 months after initial presentation, during an elective follow-up evaluation, in the absence of other clinical manifestations of HL.
